kb.a: Terra Lotus is the highest-priority live revenue deal. In the July 30 WhatsApp group, the customer requested 5,000 shampoo, 5,000 conditioner, 3,000 body wash for each of three scents (9,000 total), and 3,000 face wash. Those line items total 22,000 units, although Sam referenced 21,000; confirm the intended total before finalizing. Kenna asked Sam to send the contract and quote in the group, and Sam committed to deliver today. Pricing must include verified formula/ingredients, packaging, fill/labor, overhead, freight if applicable, and approved margin—never invent missing inputs.

PLL has moved into the new building. The active address is Private Label Labs, LLC, 24600 N. Industrial Dr., Farmington Hills, MI 48335. Customers have already been informed. UPS, USPS, and Shopify must be updated immediately, including business/origin/return locations where applicable, and each change must be validated with a saved-address check plus a test label or order workflow.

On July 30, Aiden asked whether both proposed BuffMan filling machines support hot fill. Yuhang’s forwarded freight quote is USD 8,850 DDP door-to-door; he asked what batch coding is required and indicated coding can print on bottles or labels. The quotation scope, machine configuration, coding method, and final landed cost need verification before payment, order, or shipment.

Ashley, rebranding Earth & Ash as Nymphaea, confirmed white natural paper labels and asked again July 29 for the Miron glass invoice so she can pay. Laura said a subcontracted label price takes 2–3 days and final approved rolls take about two weeks after payment; the Miron invoice/order status and label quote are not verified as complete.

Natugeda requested Hair Oil production status and a timeline. The last authenticated CRM capture listed it as Production Scheduled, but CRM is unavailable and no current stage or delivery date is verified. Operations must provide facts before any customer update.

PHYLARA’s Shannon says she is happy with the sample but is pausing the project for personal-timeline reasons. She requested the final formula/specifications and confirmation of any remaining balance. Treat this as a controlled pause: confirm release permissions, documents, and ledger status before replying.

bitop AG’s July 29 dunning notice requested payment to avoid further fees. The amount, original invoice, and any material or production hold remain unverified; finance must match it to the ledger before payment.

CH Robinson issued invoice 6247783636 for load 555812351 on July 29. The amount, due date, and shipment/customer linkage were not independently verified. Validate internally before payment or a delivery commitment.

Victor’s task is due July 31. The authoritative day update says PLL reached him; he will confirm packaging compatibility with the Edge Control formula. Full cost inputs and a final quote remain unverified.

Constance said Aleta’s first hero product is a type-4C detangler intended to provide extra slip for thick and thin hair. Formula requirements, units, packaging, launch timing, and budget remain unqualified; no MOQ or price has been promised.

Chris confirmed Australian sporting balm recipes use heating and cooling effects. U.S. heating, cooling, muscle-recovery claims, or active ingredients may trigger OTC-drug requirements. Do not quote or promise cosmetic manufacture without formula/claims review and regulatory classification.

Live CRM is at a sign-in screen July 30. The last authenticated capture showed 11 tasks, 8 overdue, 9 active deals, $1,327,800 pipeline, 20 projects in production, and $57,454.99 deposits; these are not live-verified. The customer-page Assign To dropdown was still reported broken July 28, and no verified CRM Developer closure was found.

latestOptimization.screen_text:
# PLL Ads — Improvement Recommendations for the 7 Net-New Ads
**Scope:** 7 Ads-Agent-built ads only (Contract Mfg 24049588003 + White Label Samples 24040031889). Legacy excluded. Read-only analysis; **no changes made.** Basis: trailing-7 ad-level data (7/24–7/30).

## Per-ad calls (data-backed)
| Ad group | CTR | CPC | Read | Proposed improvement |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **1B ContractMfg-Skincare** ⭐ | 44.8% | $1.00 | Clear winner, real volume | **Scale it** — raise bid modestly / lift impression share to capture more of this cheap high-intent traffic |
| **2A Samples-PrivateLabel** | 14.2% | $1.49 | Volume workhorse; CTR slipped 27.9%→14.2% | Audit keyword mix — trim broad terms pulling CTR down; hold budget |
| **1A ContractMfg-Cosmetic-Beauty** | 14.4% | $2.40 | Mid-tier, decent volume | Tighten match types; test a benefit-led headline variant (approval needed) |
| **1C ContractMfg-Haircare** ⚠️ | 9.8% | $3.84 | Worst active — highest CPC, lowest CTR | Add negatives, tighten keywords, lower bid; re-evaluate if CPC stays >$3.50 |
| **3C ProductIntent-BeardOil** 🔴 | — | — | **Dormant — 0 impressions** all week; not serving | Bid/keywords too low to enter auction — raise bid or fix keywords, else pause |
| **3A BeefTallow / 3B HairOil** | n/a | n/a | 0–1 clicks; no signal | Small bid bump to gather data OR consolidate into a broader product-intent group |

## Cross-cutting (highest leverage)
1. **Reallocate toward Skincare (1B)** — it's converting attention at $1.00 CPC while Haircare burns $3.84. Shift emphasis within existing caps; **no budget increase requested.**
2. **Fix the `search_term_view` tool gap** (blocked since 7/21) — ~68 accumulated new-lane clicks are now well past the negative-mining threshold. Tooling fix, not a budget change.
3. **Attribution coverage** — 11 of 12 leads carry no clean ad click ID; keep watching the newly-installed hidden GCLID/UTM field so paid CPL becomes real.

## Bottom line
- **What I saw:** 1B Skincare is a standout (44.8% CTR / $1.00 CPC); 1C Haircare is the cost sink ($3.84 CPC); 3C BeardOil isn't serving at all.
- **What it means:** Sample sizes are small, but the spread is wide enough to act on the extremes — scale the winner, rein in the cost sink, wake or retire the dormant ad.
- **Recommended next action:** Approve a within-cap reallocation — nudge 1B Skincare bid up and 1C Haircare bid down; fix 3C BeardOil's non-serving bid/keywords. No net budget change ($30/day, $210/wk held).
- **Approval required: YES** — bid/keyword edits to 1B, 1C, 3C. Exact bid deltas provided on approval; zero change to daily/weekly caps or to legacy campaigns.
